General information only

All content on SimplyHow is published for general informational and educational purposes. It reflects the research, testing and experience of our editors at the time of writing and updating, and nothing more.

While we work hard to keep our guides accurate, we make no representation or warranty of any kind, express or implied, that anything here is complete, accurate, current, error-free, or suitable for a particular purpose. Circumstances vary: your device, tools, budget, skill level and local regulations are your own.

No professional advice

Our guides do not constitute professional advice and no reader-relationship of trust is created by reading this site.

  • Technical and repair work - Electrical, plumbing, gas, structural and appliance work can cause fire, flooding, injury or death if done wrong. If a job requires a licensed trade, stop and hire one. When in doubt, hire a professional.
  • Health and wellness - Nothing here is medical, dental, mental-health or fitness advice. Always consult a qualified clinician before acting on health-related content, and never disregard professional guidance because of something you read here.
  • Legal - Our content is not legal advice; laws differ by country, state and city and change over time.
  • Financial - Nothing here is investment, tax or accounting advice. Verify figures with a qualified professional before acting.
  • Food safety - Cooking times and temperatures are guidelines. Use a food thermometer, follow current food-safety authority guidance, and never eat something you are unsure about.

You are solely responsible for how you use the information on this Site. Follow the manufacturer's instructions for any product you own; where our guide and a manufacturer's manual disagree, the manual wins.

Results and performance disclaimer

We cannot guarantee that following a guide will fix your problem, save you money, or produce the result shown or described. Product prices, availability, features, versions and interface layouts change constantly. Screens and descriptions may differ from what you see on your screen. Verify critical steps against current primary sources before you begin, and back up your data before any procedure that modifies it.
